workloads.name: Doppler Node WebGPU provider compare Gemma-3 270M
workloads.description: Diagnostic same-application comparison of unchanged Doppler Gemma-3 270M inference with Doe and node-webgpu as the only intended provider difference.
workloads.comparabilityNotes: Strict process-wall provider comparison. Both sides run the same Doppler source, local model, runtime configuration, tokenizer-derived prompt, and greedy 64-token decode. Generated text SHA-256 must be deterministic within each side and identical across providers before timing can be interpreted.
